features.name: duration
features.description: Difference between end and start positions, representing the span of the record.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous linear-margin signal of record span magnitude.

features.name: log_duration
features.description: Log-scaled duration to compress heavy-tailed span distribution into a smooth feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized scale improves linear SVM margin separation across order-of-magnitude differences.

features.name: log_size
features.description: Log-transformed size to reduce skew of the long-tailed size column.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearizes multiplicative size effects useful for SVM hyperplane fitting.

features.name: log_start
features.description: Log-transformed start position to compress its dynamic range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth scaled position aids linear separability.

features.name: log_end
features.description: Log-transformed end position to compress its dynamic range.

features.name: size_per_duration
features.description: Ratio of size to duration giving density-like measure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures intensity per unit span, useful as linear feature.

features.name: log_size_per_duration
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth log-density gives near-linear separating signal.

features.name: start_end_ratio
features.description: Ratio of start to end positions, normalized to [0,1] when start <= end.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized positional ratio gives bounded linear feature.

features.name: event_flag
features.description: Pass-through of the binary event indicator as a numeric feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct binary covariate for the linear margin.

features.name: event_times_log_duration
features.description: Interaction between event indicator and log duration.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows linear SVM to weight duration differently when event occurs.

features.name: id_normalized
features.description: Row id normalized to approximately [0,1] using training-set max id constant.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides smooth ordered position feature for linear projection.

features.name: size_severity_score
features.description: Semantic severity judgment of the size value mapped to a smooth 0-1 score using log-scaled thresholds: trivial (<10), small (10-100), moderate (100-500), large (500-2000), extreme (>2000), expressed as clipped log ratio.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded smooth severity proxy aligned with linear SVM weighting of magnitude regimes.
